buyer_question: Which patient, staff or operational workflow does the AI system support, and what is explicitly out of scope?
approved_answer_owner: Product owner with clinical, privacy and security review input
evidence_source: Use-case register, workflow diagram, excluded-use list, human-review policy
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim clinical safety, diagnosis, treatment suitability, patient outcome, EU AI Act classification or compliance approval without qualified owner evidence.

buyer_question: Has the AI workflow been mapped to GDPR roles, DPIA questions, retention, deletion and data-minimisation controls?
approved_answer_owner: DPO/privacy owner and legal adviser where required
evidence_source: DPIA question log, data-flow map, retention/deletion note, adviser-question register
answer_status: Adviser review required before external answer
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim GDPR compliance, DPIA completion, lawful basis, regulator approval or legal advice from this template.

question_area: EU AI Act classification and human oversight
buyer_question: Is the workflow potentially high-risk, and what human oversight, stop/escalate and model-change controls are documented?
approved_answer_owner: AI governance owner, product owner and qualified regulatory/legal adviser
evidence_source: High-risk decision log, human-review escalation policy, model-change record, external-claim approval log
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim non-high-risk status, conformity, safety, medical-device position or AI Act compliance without adviser-owned evidence.

buyer_question: Where is data hosted, which subprocessors are used, and how are cross-border transfer, retention and training-use questions answered?
evidence_source: Subprocessor list, hosting-region note, data-processing addendum source, training-use statement source
answer_status: Evidence linked; buyer-specific wording needs owner approval
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not invent data-residency guarantees, subprocessor commitments, DPA terms, deletion guarantees or no-training promises.

question_area: Cloud, LLM and vendor cost ownership
buyer_question: Who owns cloud/LLM spend, budget alerts, cost anomaly approvals, vendor-risk blockers and buyer-facing cost claims?
approved_answer_owner: CFO/FinOps owner with cloud owner and procurement owner
evidence_source: Cost-owner dashboard, budget alert log, anomaly approval runbook, vendor-risk blocker register
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim savings, ROI, cost reduction, procurement approval, production performance or ranking evidence from synthetic rows.

buyer_question: Which security, access, audit logging, incident, backup, SOC/ISO/NHS/DTAC and trust-centre answers have source evidence and owners?
approved_answer_owner: Security owner, compliance owner and procurement-response owner
evidence_source: Security questionnaire source map, access-review evidence, incident runbook, trust-centre answer library
answer_status: Answer only where source evidence exists
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim ISO, SOC 2, NHS DSPT, DTAC, audit approval, penetration-test status or certification unless independently evidenced.
